sample.description:

Whoever wins the presidency is likely to face difficult choices over how to bring the country’s debt to heel.

sample.title: Inside Man: How Chinese Spies Used Lies, Romance And Betrayal To Target The Federal Reserve
sample.description:
One week after a friendly summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump, CNBC details an aggressive plot by China to infiltrate one of the United States’ most important institutions: the Federal Reserve. This explosive documentary delves into the incredible saga of a Chinese spy's effort to obtain secrets from the inner confines of the U.S.' top bank. It's a tale of sex, money, deceit and betrayal that put some of the country’s vital economic and financial secrets at risk. With exclusive access to new documents, audio, photos and text messages, CNBC's Senior Washington Correspondent Eamon Javers uncovers the story of former Fed economist John Rogers and a Chinese spy posing as an economics student who he befriended in 2013. “Inside Man” is a spy story at the heart of the competition for global economic dominance, posing the question of whether Rogers was a spy himself or an unwitting dupe.

sample.title: Hundreds of UK prisoners being let out as new early release scheme starts | BBC News
sample.description:
Hundreds of prisoners across England and Wales are being released early today under a new scheme designed to free-up prison space. 

Offenders serving sentences of up to 19 months are now eligible for release after a third of their term.

Prisoners being released early today will include those convicted of fraud, domestic abuse and coercive control.

Restriction zones will control the movements of the most serious offenders, while the UK government promises a record roll-out of ankle monitors.

sample.title: Christa Pike taken to hospital after surviving execution, lawyer says | BBC News
sample.description:
Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike has been taken to hospital after she was still alive following two lethal injections during her execution, her lawyer says.
 
Her legal team filed an emergency motion to halt the execution as it was happening, saying: "Ms Pike has lost consciousness and still has a heartbeat and is audibly snoring."
 
One of her attorneys told the BBC that Pike, 50, was "being provided life-saving measures" in hospital after two syringes of pentobarbital had been administered.
 
There has been no comment yet from the state of Tennessee. Pike was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.

sample.title: Israel flight attack: dramatic video of passengers tackling pilot “trying to crash plane” | BBC News
sample.description:
Dramatic images filmed on board a passenger plane flying from UAE to Israel capture the moments when passengers stormed the cockpit after one pilot stabbed the other in an apparent mid-air hijack attempt.  

Distress signals from the plane triggered a major security alert, with Israel scrambling fighter jets to intercept the aircraft.

The plane, flying from Dubai to Israel, plunged around 15,000 feet, as flight control was lost.   Passengers described how one of the Flydubai pilots had stabbed his co-pilot and appeared to be intending to crash the plane. 

Passengers managed to break into the cockpit with one of the crew members and subdued the attacker. 

Other pilots on board then took control of the flight which made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia where a pilot was arrested.

Israel's prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu described the pilot who was stabbed as a hero.    The defence minister said it was an act of "jihadist terrorism". 

Clive Myrie presents BBC News at Ten reporting by Yogita Limaye in Tel Aviv.
